title: Concept: Legacy cipher selected by name in ruby — review required
description: In ruby, OpenSSL::Cipher.new is given a legacy algorithm name. DES has a 56-bit key space, 3DES is deprecated by NIST, and RC4 has known statistical biases; none of these provide the margin expected of modern transport or storage encryption. The selection often arrives through a configuration default and is never revisited.
applicability: ruby services and scripts that encrypt stored or transmitted data.
risk: Recoverable plaintext through algorithm weakness; MEDIUM severity.
